data.name: Deadly Stab
data.description: At 19th level, when the swashbuckler confirms a critical hit with a light or one-handed piercing melee weapon, she can spend 1 panache point to inflict a deadly stab. The target must succeed at a DC %1 Fortitude. On a failed saving throw, the target dies. This is a death attack. Performing this deed does not allow the swashbuckler to regain panache from confirming a critical hit or making a killing blow.|SwashbucklerDeadlyStabDC
